exposure: preoperative balloon catheter placement in internal iliac arteries
Preoperative balloon catheter placement in internal iliac arteries
outcome: Number of transfused blood products units
cohort: 53 women with ultrasound diagnosis of abnormal invasive placenta (AIP) and a planned delivery at the study institution
finding: Preoperative placement of intravascular balloon catheters for abnormal invasive placenta (AIP) was associated with reduced blood loss and transfusions in women with placenta percreta, but not in women with placenta accreta/increta.
